story_text:
As an API consumer, I want rate limiting on all endpoints so that the service remains stable under load.

AC1: 100 requests/minute per API key
AC2: 429 response with Retry-After header
AC3: Sliding window algorithm (not fixed window)
AC4: Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset
AC5: Burst allowance: 20 requests/second max
AC6: Different limits for free vs paid tiers
architecture_text: Rate limiter middleware in FastAPI. Redis-backed sliding window counters. Configurable per-endpoint and per-tier. Middleware runs before route handler.
